chapters.title: Book I
chapters.sourcePressure: The opening ledger names relatives, teachers, governors, rulers, and gods as the sources of learned restraint, simplicity, fairness, endurance, careful reading, and freedom from display.
chapters.coreMove: Turn gratitude into a practical inventory of standards you are responsible for carrying forward.
chapters.commonMisread: gratitude as soft thankfulness or a sentimental list of influences

chapters.title: Book II
chapters.sourcePressure: Morning begins with difficult people, mortality, flesh, breath, ruling part, opinion, and the need to do each act as if it were the last.
chapters.coreMove: Expect human difficulty without letting it steal cooperation or inward rule.
chapters.commonMisread: avoid difficult people or pretend their behavior does not matter

chapters.title: Book III
chapters.sourcePressure: Understanding may fail before life ends, so perception and ready principles must be trained before praise, pleasure, and curiosity waste the remaining time.
chapters.coreMove: Make haste by choosing clear judgment now, not by rushing more activity.
chapters.commonMisread: urgency as panic or speed for its own sake

chapters.title: Book IV
chapters.sourcePressure: The ruling part retreats inward, adapts to opposition like fire, examines complaint, and sees the world as a shared political community under change.
chapters.coreMove: Convert opposition and complaint into material for reasoned action.
chapters.commonMisread: obstacles are automatically good or retreat means escape

chapters.title: Book V
chapters.sourcePressure: Morning reluctance is answered by human function, social labor, quick resets, action without scorekeeping, bitter prescriptions from common nature, and repeated return.
chapters.coreMove: Rise from comfort into the human work that belongs to your nature.
chapters.commonMisread: get up earlier and work harder for status

chapters.title: Book VI
chapters.sourcePressure: Cosmic order widens self-command into public reason: duty holds in cold, warmth, praise, blame, life, death, and the bee is not separate from the swarm.
chapters.coreMove: Keep duty independent of mood, image, and convenience while staying social.
chapters.commonMisread: do your duty by pleasing everyone or seeking public image

chapters.title: Book VII
chapters.sourcePressure: Dense maxims reanimate principles against familiar badness, future fear, pain, fame, death, first appearances, and unused social help.
chapters.coreMove: Keep principles alive by renewing the matching thought at the moment pressure returns.
chapters.commonMisread: memorize maxims and assume remembering equals living

chapters.title: Book VIII
chapters.sourcePressure: Seeming philosophical is rejected in favor of present useful action, correction without blame, dropping complaint, and using hindered plans as material.
chapters.coreMove: Replace appearance management and complaint with the next correctable useful act.
chapters.commonMisread: look authentic while doing the same delayed behavior

chapters.title: Book IX
chapters.sourcePressure: Injustice and lying are impiety against shared rational nature; right opinion, social conduct, contentment, correction without anger, and mild strength follow.
chapters.coreMove: Answer wrongdoing with truth and correction without adding private fever.
chapters.commonMisread: justice means anger, denunciation, or moral performance

chapters.title: Book X
chapters.sourcePressure: The soul is tested for simplicity, contentment, correct names, condition-independent goodness, and clear judgment of praise, bodies, courts, and changing substance.
chapters.coreMove: Hold the few names of character so conditions cannot rename you.

chapters.title: Book XI
chapters.sourcePressure: The rational soul completes each act, examines pleasures by parts, works for general interest, cuts hatred from the social tree, and trains anger by nine rules.
chapters.coreMove: Complete the social act without letting anger cut you off from the whole.

chapters.title: Book XII
chapters.sourcePressure: The close compresses everything into present piety and justice, the divine within, separating impressions, practice, pancratiast readiness, truth, and clean departure.
chapters.coreMove: Live the present so cleanly that death finds you already begun.
chapters.commonMisread: death reflection as gloom or dramatic renunciation
